Greetings Chaos Lords! ⚔️ You may now download version 3.0.2 of Warhammer: Chaos & Conquest!⁣⁣


📣 Full patch notes for the update are as follows!

Multiple Warlords in Marches & Warbands

 Players can now place up to 3 Warlords into both Marches and Warbands and this can be done by completing 2 new Rituals within the Mastery Ritual Tree.
 These new Rituals will require level 8 and 15 of the Sorcerers Citadel.

Warband Loss Improvements

 When damage is taken by a Warband, it’ll be distributed evenly across the Warband for all players with the same unit types. These losses are proportional, if you add 200 units and another player adds 100 of the same type and the Warband loses 150 of that unit overall then you lose 100 and the other player loses 50.

March Customization

 Players can now use warlord buffs when reinforcing allies and joining warbands. These buffs will only affect your march, not the Warband or player you're reinforcing. An example of this would be to use a Warlord to improve the march speed so you can reach your allies in a shorter timeframe.  A new Superior Daily Trial chest has been added as a reward for completing 18 daily trials, which includes Warlord Shards!
 There have been a number of new trials added to support the new Superior Daily Trial challenge.

Unannounced Event

notes.title: June Development Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Mighty Lords! Today we’re sharing details about the next new structure for Chaos and Conquest. As mentioned earlier this year, we are working on a list of highly requested 'quality of life' features alongside new content, and we’ll be sharing some previews in the next blog in a few week's time. Today we’d like to show you the new trading structure that we mentioned earlier this year - the Raider’s Market! This structure has a large array of items for trade and, unlike other structures, does not need to be upgraded to access its full potential.

At the Raider’s Market, players will be able to trade their excess components for a variety of useful items such as Warlord Favour, Shields, Boosts, Resources, Mission Refreshes, Stamina Potions, VIP Time and more. The items available to purchase will rotate each day within the Raider’s Market, and each day a different component will be used to make these exchanges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36106554/c10629b74ea96fdceeca7c666322297373dda771.png

For example, one day it could be ‘Offerings of Skulls’ available for trade and throughout the day you could trade these for the above items, and the following day it could be Vessels of Wrath. Initially, all existing structure and unit components will be potentially used in Raider’s trades, so make sure you check the market daily. This feature will allow players who have a surplus of these inventory items for more valuable resources and loot. 

We expect the next game update in around a month's time, and we’ll be sharing more of what to expect in the coming weeks! We hope you enjoyed this sneak peak at the Raider's Market.

GAME UPDATE 1.20.20

Features

 Added 4 new Fortress Skins.
- Blood Bastion (Khorne)
- Blighted Stronghold (Nurgle)
- Palace of Rapture (Slaanesh)
- Shifting Spire (Tzeentch)
 Added a new currency - Daemonic Fulgurite
 Added 2 new types of challenges.
- Infernal Challenges feature cross-region leaderboards.
- 4 Infernal challenges have been added.
- Legion Challenges, work together as an alliance to achieve challenge tiers!
- 4 Legion challenges have been added.
 Added a new item set - Vanquisher Set.
 Advance Combat Breakdown is now available, see an expanded turn by turn summary of every battle, and use this information to help crush your opponents, both the Empire and your rival Chaos Lords.
 Alliance members' contributions can now be viewed for both Legion and Alliance challenges via a new contributors button.
 All challenges have now been updated to use the improve bracket and leaderboard rewards loot tables.


General

 Improved the loot table for the Warlord Chest, it now includes Legendary Souls and both the 
 Added an icon above the capture pit if the player has any captured Champions.

 Added additional Warpstone spend confirmation popup to buildings, research, training and healing.
 Players can now view ally champions to see equipment loadouts.

 All Sawbones levels healing speed increased

- 21 - 30 + 1%
 Added restrictions to power (200k max power) when trying to relocate regions at keep level 7 or lower
